title: salvia wuana
intro: Salvia wuana, commonly known as Wuana sage or Tibetan sage, is a plant species in the sage genus (Salvia) of flowering plants. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving cognitive function, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Salvia wuana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant has been traditionally used in Tibetan medicine to promote relaxation and reduce symptoms of insomnia and other sleep disorders.
